Renforcement de la cybersécurité

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Renforcement de la cybersécurité?

In this glossary, Renforcement de la cybersécurité refers to: The process of applying security measures to reduce cyberattack risk on aircraft systems and networks (EASA, ICAO Doc 10117).

How is Renforcement de la cybersécurité used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Des mesures de renforcement de la cybersécurité ont été mises en place après la détection d’une vulnérabilité réseau dans l’avionique."

Why does Renforcement de la cybersécurité matter in aviation?

Renforcement de la cybersécurité matters because it supports clear communication in Advanced ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Renforcement de la cybersécurité?

Renforcement de la cybersécurité is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Renforcement de la cybersécurité belong to?

In this glossary, Renforcement de la cybersécurité is grouped under Advanced ATC. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.
